translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of low back pain, bruises, sprains, shoulder pain, joint pain, muscle pain, muscle fatigue, frostbite, and pain from fractures.
translation.usage: Apply 1 patch once or twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: the area around the eyes; mucous membranes; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like, or wounded areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to this medicine or to cosmetics; people with severe moist skin or erosion. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only; do not take it by mouth. If your symptoms do not improve after several days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash; redness (congestion and reddening); itching. Store at room temperature, protected from light. Keep out of reach of children.
